messages:
maria: Rolling a config-only change to egress routing + batching. Starting a 2% canary in ~5m. Deploy bot will run. Patch touches egress_limit, batch_timeout, backpressure. Please standby for metrics and shout if anything looks off.

deploy-bot: /deploy start-canary config=infra/routing/egress-v2.yaml percent=2 duration=15m initiated by maria

cheng: thx. can you paste the config here?

maria: sure
```yaml
routing:
  egress_limit_per_tenant: 0.8
  batch_timeout_ms: 25
  backpressure_threshold: 0.6
  route_policy: "geo-aware-weighted"
```

vika: pinging #support. any pinned model version changes? we should avoid model pins in config-onlys.

maria: no model pins, only runtime config. will not change model variants.

samir: I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and kv-cache hitrate during canary. recommend we also check qps/node and steady-state throughput.

deploy-bot: canary progress: 2% -> health checks passing (5/5 replicas), metrics streaming: no errors so far

ops-oncall: seeing a small p99 bump on a host, looking into logs (no 5xx yet)

samir: noticed increased tail ~1.2x on host i-03a3, likely cold kv-cache after routing shift. investigating prewarm.

maria: hold ramp to 10% until we understand. pausing deploy.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 2% by maria

cheng: should we roll back or iterate? if kv-cache warmup fixes it in ~10m we can continue.

samir: forced kv-cache prewarm on i-03a3; tail returned to baseline in ~6m, p99 back to normal.

ops-oncall: confirmed, no increased error budget burn. thumbs up to continue to 10%.

maria: ok resuming. /deploy resume-canary percent=10

deploy-bot: resuming canary to 10% (initiated by maria)

vika: FYI I've updated the release notes draft: "egress routing guardrails tightened; lowered batch timeout for lower P50 latency; backpressure threshold adjusted to favor graceful degradation"

maria: good. let's keep a 30m passive monitor after reaching 100% and alert if p99 > baseline * 1.25 or kv-cache hitrate drops >10%

deploy-bot: canary reached 100% and marked successful. release metadata: config-only, no model changes, changed by maria, rollout=2026-03-21T17:04Z

cheng: thanks all. looks stable. will update the changelog and ops playbook. :thumbsup:
